title: Invite - Formal Launch of Live Streaming of Court Proceedings of High Court of Gujarat by Honourable the Chief Justice of India
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARATHIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
Honourable the Chief Justice and Honourable Judges
of the High Court of Gujarat invite you to witness online
the historical moment of the High Court of Gujarat
INAUGURAL FUNCTION
FORMAL LAUNCH OF LIVE STREAMING OF
COURT PROCEEDINGS &
RELEASE OF LIVE STREAMING RULES
GUEST OF HONOUR
HONOURABLE DR. JUSTICE D.Y. CHANDRACHUD
JUDGE, SUPREME COURT OF INDIA &
CHAIRMAN, ECOMMITTEE, SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
On Saturday the 17th July, 2021 at 05.30 PM
On YouTube Channel of the High Court of Gujarat
https://www.youtube.com/c/GujaratHighCourtLive
INAUGURATION BY THE CHIEF GUEST
HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE N. V. RAMANA
THE CHIEF JUSTICE OF INDIA
SPECIAL GUEST
HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE M. R. SHAH
JUDGE, SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
